title: How a Godly Man Stays Humble When Everyone's Praising Him
caption:
A godly man gets praised and still gets on his knees. Sturdy isn't the same as soft. It isn't the same as proud either.

Let someone else say it first. Name who actually gets the credit. Keep the same posture in private that you keep in public. Take the correction without the defense.

What do you have that you didn't receive?
